rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an early, poorly expanded blastocyst with no clear ICM and poor/disorganized TE, consistent with 0DD. Minor overinterpretation from a single static image (e.g., coarse/granular appearance, limited comment on zona/collapse) prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, elevated FSH, low MII yield, male factor context, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is internally consistent and well structured: poor morphology plus age and low mature oocyte yield logically support a very low implantation estimate and counseling emphasis on embryo biology.

Generally aligns well with Gardner grading interpretation and evidence-based IVF counseling, including caution against unproven adjuvants. Slight speculative elements around ovarian reserve and selective day-3 transfer discussion keep it from a perfect score.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including luteal support adherence, counseling, ovarian reserve workup, trigger review, insemination strategy review, and male-factor refinement.
